source.title: Senior Delegate Announcement - Latin America (March 2025)
source.content:
We are happy to announce we have a new Senior Delegate, Guido Dipietro, for Latin America. 


Guido was selected by the WCA Board by voting among them, following Section 4 of our [Motion](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2025.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf) about Senior Delegates.


We extend our support and best wishes to Guido in fulfilling his new responsibilities. His term as Senior Delegate started March 4, 2025.


Guido was among 3 applicants we had for the Senior Delegate (Latin America) role. The candidacy documents can be found [here](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1tOta3ScssMLiME_XqlNhKzCA5kYqM7vw).


In addition to Guido, the other applicants were:

- Ignacio Naval

- João Vinícius de A. Santos

translation.title: 拉丁美洲高级代表任命公告（2025 年 3 月）
translation.content:
我们很高兴地宣布，Guido Dipietro 将担任拉丁美洲地区的新任高级代表。

WCA 董事会依照高级代表[动议](https://documents.worldcubeassociation.org/documents/motions/09.2025.1%20-%20Senior%20Delegates.pdf)第 4 节的规定，通过内部投票选定了 Guido。

我们支持 Guido，并祝愿他顺利履行新的职责。他的高级代表任期自 2025 年 3 月 4 日开始。

拉丁美洲高级代表一职共有 3 人申请，Guido 是其中之一。申请材料可在[此处](https://drive.google.com/drive/folders/1tOta3ScssMLiME_XqlNhKzCA5kYqM7vw)查看。

另外两位申请者是：

- Ignacio Naval
- João Vinícius de A. Santos
